hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: date, population, food, coin

hud.event-card.lord-moment.data: the lord's suit filed: its Wave 40 picture and the ledger's sentence

modal.year-review.data: 1302's card at 1303's first tick: its decisions (or none), the factions' moves, the town's people and money

modal.famine.data: chapter 1's famine decision (DEC-CARD: four answers, the steward beside the stake)

modal.petition.heir.data: the heir's card with three candidates

modal.history.records.data: the stone town's chronicle: timeline, filters, record list, detail

modal.history.snapshot-figure.data: the then-map with its caption (the caption measured beside the framed box)

modal.history.biography.king.data: the king's biography: the empty-records line

modal.history.factions.data: chapter 4's factions: influence, tug of war, relations

modal.history.factions-panel.data: the nine factions' rows in Wave 14's faction panel, the kind icons beside four names

modal.lord.home-petition.data: the boundary dispute (Wave 44 01) in the DEC-CARD layout: the situation, the stake, each answer now / later / who remembers

modal.lord.home-petition.guardian.data: a minor lord's wardship petition (the court line with his guardian)

modal.lord.request.data: the town's request (a proclamation waiting) in the DEC-CARD layout: the grant's now (the works it opens) and later (the actual's day)

modal.house-change.wardship.data: a minor lord's wardship begun (Wave 40 13): who, the guardian, no right changed, his card as the next act — before the boundary dispute's card

modal.house-change.inherited.data: the neighbour's estate inherited (Wave 40 08): the old lord's death, the title and possession, five debts promised, the estates screen as the next act

modal.lord.registry.data: the first v4 offer the registry drew in the lord's slice (DEC-CARD layout): its why, each answer's tradeoff, now / later / who remembers, the shut one with why

modal.lord.registry-hold.data: the first v4 offer with a hold the lord can choose (DEC-CARD layout): the hold's cost as the engine's run shows it (the claim weakened)

lord.receipt.data: a town-built farmstead's receipt: five reasons, the next best site, the chance, the 10d subsidy and its decisions

lord.receipt-old.data: the same receipt from a save before the chance was kept

lord.receipt-none.data: the opening well: no receipt, the reason instead of an empty frame

lord.receipt-inspector.data: the first store's receipt (or why it has none) from the left inspector

slot.ledger.stock-lord.data: the lord's slice stock tab: the treasury by estate under the treasury line, then the stocks

lord.screen.data: the lord screen host over the town: the left menu (each shut item with its reason) and the screen (empty until an area opens one)

lord.negotiation.draft.data: the marriage offer before any is sent: the grooms, the clause editor, the draft treaty (consent alone), the counterpart's tier and reasons, the refusal (no terms) under a shut offer button

lord.negotiation.counter.data: the counterpart's counter waiting a season: the clauses with the one it added marked, its tier and reasons, the deadline and what silence means, each answer's now / later / who remembers (DEC-CARD), accept and refuse as equal choices

lord.negotiation.will-change.data: the marriage's progress with the will change due: the events as they fell, the deferred debt, the contract's clauses under a stamped seal

lord.negotiation.contested.data: the estate contested after the will stood: the rival named, the outcome, the way to its suit on the ledger screen

lord.ledger.promises.data: the promise ledger with kept, broken and open debt instalments (the lord keeps them from the treasury), the lord's open claim

lord.ledger.empty.data: no promise yet (the marriage only offered): the empty ledger's lines, no timed terms, the lord's claim with its filing button

lord.ledger.suit.data: the contested inheritance's suit just filed: the stage track, the hearing's two sides, the five evidence kinds to bring; two claims to file

lord.ledger.neighbour.data: the lord's two closed suits (judged, enforced) and a neighbour's recovery suit against him, shown with no command

lord.estates.home.data: the estates screen on the home estate: the totals, the attention, the four estates to choose, the home card with its pieces and grants, the exceptions, the petitions

lord.estates.delegated.data: the inherited estate given to the greedy steward: its card with the overlay, the steward and the two other candidates, the audit by visit, its first season

lord.estates.overloaded.data: the same estate taken direct while a visit's year lowers the attention: load 2 over capacity 1, the warning, the receiver, three seasons

lord.estates.audit-pending.data: a visit's audit waiting for the lord's answer: what it found and the days left (the answer is the decision card's)

lord.region.data: the region map on the inherited state: the home direct, the inherited estate delegated to its steward (chosen, its line under the map), two neighbours; the map fitted

lord.region.zoomed.data: the region map at full zoom on the neighbour-suit state: the first neighbour chosen (its flag a neighbour's, the pieces the lord won of it listed), the map scrolled to it

modal.lord.will-change.data: the father's new will: favour (shut when the treasury is short), support promised (its promise, stake and witnesses), let it stand (the rival's claim) — the engine's run

modal.lord.contested.data: the contested inheritance: the rival's hold, both claims' strength, the lord's suit stage, the way to the suit

modal.lord.audit.data: a Michaelmas audit's finding: punish, replace, tolerate — what each recovers, who follows, who remembers

modal.lord.offmap-petition.data: an off-map estate's petition: why it came to the lord, both answers' treasury and the estate's goodwill

lord.standing.data: the standing policies: the manor's twelve petitions (with the all-to-the-lord switch, rules.recurring), the off-map estates' six, the senders' five, each with its setting

lord.standing.kind.data: the heriot opened: the four settings (all secondary, the one in force pressed) and what each would do, this year's count

hud.event-card.trace.data: the season's news of the lord's decision (the suit filed on the first tick): its year and subject, the neighbour's mind, the way to the chronicle

modal.history.thread-decision.data: the suit filed in 1300, opened from its later chip: what followed (its turns) and who remembers it

modal.history.thread-because.data: a suit's turn: the decision it followed from (the year and who decided), its link back

modal.house-change.lord-died.data: the engine's succession: the lord's death and his heir in the ledger's sentence, who leads the house now
